title: Potato sack material?  Seriously?/
text: Potato sack material?  Seriously?/. The letters are made from potato sack material.  Very disappointing indeed.  The hearts are made of hard cardboard, which is a saving grace.  Not worth the money.  If you are looking at it from a distance, maybe not a big issue.  Really would like to return this item.
